# Functional Context

## Purpose

This fictional demonstration data describes a customer onboarding capability for the demo project.

## Scope

The demonstration covers account creation as the first onboarding step.

## Business Process

A prospective customer submits account details, receives confirmation, and proceeds to the next onboarding step.

## Users and Stakeholders

Prospective customers create accounts. The fictional onboarding team owns the experience.

## Business Rules

An account requires a valid email address and acceptance of the demonstration terms.

## Assumptions and Constraints

This content is fictional demonstration data and does not describe a live service.
